newsitem.title: USA: Three-Five Systems Inc sees Q3 loss.
newsitem.headline: Three-Five Systems Inc sees Q3 loss.

text.p: Three-Five Systems Inc said it will take a "significant reserve" in its third quarter to allow for possible excess inventories and that "taking into account the maximum charge" for excess inventories, it expects to report a third quarter operating loss of $0.60 to $0.70 per share.
The company said as much as 80 percent of the loss will be attributable to the inventory reserve. It also said the forecast loss was based on expected third quarter revenues of $13 million.
The company said it earned $0.17 per share on sales of $24.2 million in the year-ago third quarter.

"The inventory reserve is primarily related to end-of-life programs for which the majority of shipments were expected to occur in the latter part of 1996," Three-Five chief financial officer Jeffrey Buchanan said in a statement.

Although we are using every effort to minimize the amount of inventory that will ultimately be considered to be excess, our customary practice dictates that once an excess condition has been identified or indicated it must be fully reserved. He said the company recently took steps to minimize such problems.
